feed.title: SLB, Formentera Working to Activate Drilling Rigs in Venezuela, Executives Say
feed.summary: Oil service provider SLB and private equity firm Formentera Partners are actively working to reactivate or import drilling rigs into Venezuela to boost its crude production capacity. Despite current obstacles like importing equipment and negotiating with the Venezuelan government, SLB anticipates reactivating up to 15 rigs within a year, with a few expected to be operational by year-end, while Formentera is in discussions with international service providers for additional rigs. This effort comes as Venezuela seeks to expand its oil production, though challenges related to power supply, supply chains, and contract protection remain.

feed.title: Court Narrows Claims in Archer–Joby Legal Dispute
feed.summary: A federal court has narrowed several claims against Archer Aviation in its legal dispute with Joby Aero, Inc., dismissing some trade-secret and contract claims while allowing others to continue. feed.title: Apple Takes Aim at AI Agents, Wants Mac Users to Know When Their Data Is Accessed as Meta Tackles Muse Privacy Claims
feed.summary: Apple plans to update macOS to notify users when AI agents, like Meta's Muse, try to access system data, addressing privacy concerns. This move comes after criticism that AI agents, which can bypass standard protections with "Full Disk Access," might expose sensitive personal information. Apple emphasized its commitment to user privacy and will implement new security controls requiring explicit user action for such data access.

feed.title: AAPL To Flag AI Requests For Data Access On Macs Amid Complaints Over META's Muse Agent
feed.summary: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is enhancing privacy controls on Mac computers by requiring more explicit user action for applications to gain broad access to data via its Full Disk Access feature, citing risks from increasingly autonomous AI agents. This move follows criticisms regarding Meta Platforms Inc.'s (META) Muse AI agent and its alleged access to private Messages content, though Meta disputes these claims. Apple emphasizes the need for users to make informed decisions about data access in the era of advanced AI.
